subject: MSA + Order Form: assurance cutover and evidence onramp
messages:
From: Emily Wong <emily.wong@proteanthera.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Protean Legal <legal@proteanthera.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / Order form — security exhibit questions and redlines

Hi Laura / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Our legal and security teams reviewed the MSA + Order Form package and attached a short set of comments against the Security Exhibit (see attached Protean_SecurityExhibit_Comments_v2.docx). High-level asks:

- Narrow the inspection right language so it doesn't allow on-demand multi-day access to production environments; we prefer an evidence-onramp model (deliver artifacts + 30-day advanced notice for deeper inspection).
- Confirm you can provide a current SOC 2 Type II report and a redacted penetration-test report (or a summary) as part of the pre-sales security package.
- Define the pen-test window options (customer staging vs. vendor-managed) and whether Redwood will allow scoped, timeboxed tests with limited blast radius.
- Request a documented evidence cadence: what artifacts will be delivered, format, how frequently, and retention period.
- Clarify whether the Order Form can reference an Assurance Appendix (separate doc) with technical details and runbook vs baking everything into the MSA.

Can we get a short mutual action plan (MAP) mapping these items to owners and dates? Protean's legal would prefer to avoid broad "inspection at reasonable times" language — they asked for either (a) a defined evidence delivery schedule or (b) a bounded inspection flow with explicit notice and sampling limits.

We also attached line edits in the doc. Hoping to get this wrapped quickly so we can finish the order-form signature.

Attachments: Protean_SecurityExhibit_Comments_v2.docx (docx)

Thanks,

Emily Wong
Head of IT Security, Protean Therapeutics
emily.wong@proteanthera.com
+1 415-555-0192

--

On Thu, 5 Jul 2028 at 10:05 AM laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Sent calendar invite for the follow-up call.

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Wong <emily.wong@proteanthera.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order form — security exhibit questions and redlines

Emily — thanks for the clear notes and attached redlines. We appreciate the specificity; that makes it straightforward to propose a compact path forward.

Quick summary of what Redwood can commit to today:
- We'll provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II attestation in full (or a certified copy) and a redacted penetration-test report (sensitive infrastructure details removed).
- For on-demand inspection language, we propose two mutually exclusive options for the MSA Security Exhibit:
  1) Evidence-onramp: Redwood delivers a predefined artifact bundle on a cadence (see below) and Protean may request a deeper inspection with 30 days' notice, capped at two inspections per rolling 12 months.
  2) Bounded inspection: allow limited remote/virtual inspection with a maximum 3 business day window after 30 days' notice, scoped to non-production or staging instances unless explicit arrangement is made.

Artifact / evidence cadence (proposed):
- Quarterly: SOC 2 bridge letter (if required), updated control matrix (CSV), architecture snapshot (redacted diagram), and a summary of any security incidents with remediation notes.
- Annually: Full SOC 2 Type II report and a high-level pen-test executive summary.
- On request (with 30 days' notice and NDA/controls in place): sample logs and evidence sets for scoped assertions (retained for 12 months unless otherwise agreed).

Next steps I propose (MAP):
1) Redwood to return a clean Security Exhibit and an Assurance Appendix with technical runbook by EOD Friday 7/6 — owner: laura_bennett.
2) Protean to confirm which inspection option (Evidence-onramp vs Bounded inspection) by Tue 7/9 — owner: Protean Legal.
3) Security ops sync (technical) to walk evidence handoff and staging capabilities — schedule week of 7/10; owner: ben_carter + Protean security lead.
4) Finalize Order Form language and push to DocuSign by 7/15 pending redlines.

I've attached a short Redwood_Assurance_Appendix_v1.docx (internal draft) that matches the evidence cadence above — it can be referenced from the Order Form to keep the MSA concise.

If that MAP looks reasonable I'll also loop in our security engineering lead for the technical sync.

Thanks — talk soon.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 612-555-0134

Attachments: Redwood_Assurance_Appendix_v1.docx (docx)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Wong <emily.wong@proteanthera.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order form — security exhibit questions and redlines

Looping in a quick technical note from SecOps perspective —

Hi Emily — quick responses inline to help Protean decide the inspection option: 
- SOC 2 report: yes, current copy available; we circulate a full report under NDA.
- Pen-test deliverables: we can provide a redacted report and a one-page executive summary that lists findings and remediation status. Full raw results are not provided for obvious security reasons, but we can run a 1:1 review with your security team under a controlled session.
- Pen-test window: preferred approach is vendor-run on Redwood staging (minimized blast radius). If Protean wants to run application-level tests against a customer staging environment, we'll require a pre-signed risk acknowledgment and an agreed test plan; typical windows are 2–3 business days.
- Evidence delivery mechanics: we support SFTP, secure SharePoint link, or a short-term S3 presigned URL (enterprise agreement required). All artifacts are access-logged.

Operational constraint: we operate a rolling 12-month retention for most raw logs; we can extend retention for contract customers with a small add-on.

I'll be on the technical sync if scheduled.

— Ben Carter
Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Protean Legal <legal@proteanthera.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Wong <emily.wong@proteanthera.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Jul 2028 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order form — security exhibit questions and redlines

Laura / Ben — thank you. Protean reviewed your proposed options and attached a short redline that attempts to balance commercial needs with our compliance obligations (Protean_Legal_Redlines.docx).

Key clarifications from our side: 
- We like the Evidence-onramp option but need explicit language that evidence will be delivered in a machine-readable control-mapping format and retained for at least 18 months for our internal audit cycle.
- Protean requires the ability to sample artifacts (logs, configuration snapshots) for up to 2 days per request, not to exceed 3 such samplings per 12-month period. Sampling to be executed with an agreed test plan and minimal access (read-only).
- We request a documented escalation path if artifacts are unavailable during an evidence delivery slot — a named Redwood security contact and a 5-business-day remediation window.
- We also flagged one MSA clause that references unrestricted inspection rights; we propose replacing that clause with the Evidence-onramp text and a cross-reference to the Assurance Appendix.

Attached: Protean_Legal_Redlines.docx (docx)

Please confirm whether Redwood can accept the 18-month retention and the sampling caps above; if not, let us know the counterproposal so we can present to Protean's audit team.

Regards,
Protean Legal
legal@proteanthera.com

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Protean Legal <legal@proteanthera.com>, Emily Wong <emily.wong@proteanthera.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Jul 2028 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order form — security exhibit questions and redlines

Thanks — clear and actionable. Agreed next steps and our counterpoints below so everyone has the same view before the technical sync: 

1) Retention: Redwood can extend retention of the control-mapping and selected evidence sets to 18 months for Protean under the Order Form (will include small add-on fee). Owner: laura_bennett / commercial.
2) Sampling caps: we can accept Protean's sampling proposal (2 days per request, max 3 per 12 months) provided all sampling is executed as read-only and limited to non-production artifacts unless jointly approved. Owner: ben_carter / secops.
3) Escalation path: Redwood will add a named security contact and a 5-business-day remediation SLA to the Assurance Appendix; if resolution is not met, contract escalation runs to Redwood's Head of Legal. Owner: karthik_iyer / legal.
4) Evidence format: we'll deliver the control mapping as a CSV export and provide a shareable, access-logged location (S3 presigned link or SharePoint) by the cadence specified.

I'll push an updated Security Exhibit + Assurance Appendix to the shared Drive (link above) and prepare a redline of the MSA clause for signature. Can we aim to do the technical evidence handoff call on Tue 7/11 11:00 AM PT? I sent a calendar invite — please accept if that works.

If Protean is good with the above I'll circulate a final Order Form for signature the week of 7/15.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to the sync.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
